summary: Appeal under Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction challenging High Court order in Criminal Revision; condonation of delay in filing SLP; locus standi of Teesta Setalvad questioned; discussion of SIT directions, NHRC involvement, and reporting under CrPC; background from Godhra/Gulberg Society case; leave to appeal granted; merits to be examined.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 173(8) of the Code of Criminal Procedure
